Experience Italy like never before! In this video, we take you through 3 unforgettable Italian adventures — from learning to make authentic fresh pasta with locals, to a breathtaking boat tour along the coast, and an exciting Vespa ride through charming streets and countryside.

• Introduction

• Pasta Making Experience
